fields.name: description
fields.description: A textual explanation or summary of the record.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL-friendly identifier, for records opened by address instead of id.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The record's rich-text body as HTML, edited in place by the document look.

fields.name: coverUrl
fields.description: The document look's cover/hero image URL, stamped from the loaded row's coverField.

fields.name: iconName
fields.description: The document look's icon name, stamped from the loaded row's iconField.

fields.name: loadedRow
fields.description: The full row exactly as last fetched (relations hydrated when config.include asks). The details drawer binds it, and hosts that need it (e.g. a settings modal) stash it from RecordItemLoaded — the document panel itself takes only scalar props and emits scalar payloads ({ id, title }).

fields.name: openDraft
fields.description: Set from the navigate payload when the surface was opened on a record that was JUST minted blank; read once the row loads to decide whether the document body opens authoring (draft) or read-only. Absent on a refresh or a normal open, so the draft entry never repeats.
fields.synonyms: new document, just created, draft open

events.name: RecordItemLoaded
events.description: Signals that the record has been successfully loaded.
events.synonyms: loaded, received, ready, fetched

events.name: RecordItemSlugLoaded
events.description: A slug-routed record finished loading; the payload is a collection whose first element is the record. Composing traits that need the loaded row (comments scoping, status controls) listen to this.
events.synonyms: loaded by address, slug resolved, record found

events.name: RecordItemLoadFailed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load the record.
events.synonyms: error, failed, problem, unsuccessful

events.name: EDIT
events.description: Signals a request to edit the record being viewed.
events.synonyms: modify, update, change

events.name: DELETE
events.description: Signals a request to remove the record being viewed.
events.synonyms: remove, discard, delete, archive

events.name: CONTENT_SAVED
events.description: The document look's autosave stream: fired at every typing pause while editing, and once more on Done. This atom never persists — the composing organism routes CONTENT_SAVED into a QUIET persist (one that does not refetch or repaint this surface, or the editor unmounts mid-keystroke).
events.synonyms: autosave, saved, persist content, draft saved

events.name: CONTENT_COMMITTED
events.description: The author finished the document editing session (pressed Done). Hosts refetch the row, repaint, and snapshot version history on THIS event — never on the CONTENT_SAVED autosave stream.
events.synonyms: done, finished editing, commit, snapshot

events.name: TITLE_COMMITTED
events.description: The viewer renamed the record in place by editing the document title; carries the committed title and the row id for a partial persist.
events.synonyms: rename, retitle, change title, edit title

events.name: EDIT_CONTENT
events.description: The viewer clicked the document body (or its Edit button) to start an editing session.
events.synonyms: edit, start editing, click to edit

events.name: DONE_EDITING
events.description: The viewer pressed Done to end the document editing session.
events.synonyms: done, finish, stop editing

events.name: INIT
events.description: Opens the detail surface for one record: by id, or by slug for address-routed records (the internal re-fetch after an update still carries id). `draft` is set only by a document-first create's navigate, and opens the document look's body straight in the editor.
events.synonyms: open record, view record, show details, drill in

events.name: OPEN_VIEW
events.description: A row was opened from a list; shows that record in this surface.
events.synonyms: open record, view row, show details, drill in, expand

events.name: CONTENT_CHANGE
events.description: The rich text surface reported an edit (already debounced to typing pauses by the component).
events.synonyms: typing, content changed, body edited

events.name: CLOSE_VIEW
events.description: Closes the record surface and returns it to blank.
events.synonyms: close, dismiss, back to list

events.name: RETRY
events.description: Re-runs the fetch after a failed load.
events.synonyms: try again, reload, refresh

overridableConfigKeys.label: What actions can users take on this record?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Buttons on the panel header. One primary at most; the rest collapse past maxInlineActions.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: record actions, detail actions, panel buttons

overridableConfigKeys.label: Allow editing the document?
overridableConfigKeys.description: When false the document look is a pure read surface: no header Edit button, no click-to-edit body, no click-to-rename title. Hosts pass a role condition here so read-only viewers get the page without its authoring affordances; the entity's own access predicates stay the enforcement floor.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: read only document, viewer mode, can edit, editing allowed

overridableConfigKeys.label: Autosave hint
overridableConfigKeys.description: Muted caption next to the Done button telling the author their work persists on its own.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field is the avatar?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the image field shown as the profile look's avatar; the title supplies initials when it is empty.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: photo field, avatar field, picture field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Body content tree
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = panel (the default). See slideOverBodyContent/pageBodyContent for the other looks; any may be overridden directly while inheriting the same trait, state machine, emits, and listens.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which action closes the record?
overridableConfigKeys.description: The `actions` entry whose event matches renders as the panel's close (×) button. Empty = no close button (a routed detail page navigates back instead).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: close event, dismiss event, close button

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field holds the document body?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the field on the loaded record that carries the rich-text HTML body the document look renders and edits (e.g. content, body, articleText).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: body field, content field, document field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field is the cover image?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the image-typed field on the loaded record painted as the hero banner of the document look and of the profile record look (e.g. coverImage, heroImage). Empty = no banner, the default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: cover field, hero image field, banner field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Detail look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Visual treatment for the record surface. panel = an inline detail-panel in the page flow (bodyContent); slide-over = the same panel as a right-hand drawer over the list behind it (slideOverBodyContent); page = a full-width record page with roomier spacing (pageBodyContent); document = a wiki-page/note/article surface — big editable title over a rich-text body, no labelled field rows, click-to-edit with autosave (documentBodyContent / documentEditingContent). Selecting a look swaps which body tree renders after the record loads; any body may still be overridden directly at the call site.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: detail style, drawer, slide over, full page, document, wiki page, note, article

overridableConfigKeys.label: Document look body (reading)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr for detailLook = document while reading: the pure writing surface — editable title with the rich-text body DIRECTLY beneath it, Edit and the actions menu tucked into the header corner. Metadata never sits between title and content; compose the sibling RecordItemDetails trait beside this one for the settings rail. Binds only @entity fields, never ?data, because it is also painted by arms whose payload is not the record.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Document look body (editing)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr for detailLook = document during an editing session: the same surface with the body live and the header corner showing the autosave hint + Done. Binds only @entity fields, never ?data.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Done button label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label of the button that ends the document editing session; work is already autosaved when it is pressed.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Edit button label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label of the quiet button above the document body that starts an editing session (the body itself is also clickable).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which fields appear in the record panel?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Each entry maps one entity field to a labelled row in the panel. Unlike a list row, a detail panel SHOULD label every field — the value stands alone here with no column header or repeated row position to name it.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: detail fields, record fields, panel fields, shown fields

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field is the document icon?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the field on the loaded record whose icon name renders beside the document title (e.g. icon). Empty = no icon, the default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: icon field, glyph field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which relation fields to hydrate?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity relation field names to hydrate on fetch, so panel fields can use dot-paths like owner.name. Empty = no hydration, the default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: relation hydration, populate relations, joined fields

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field is the latitude?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the latitude field the map look pins.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which line-item columns?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Columns of the ledger look's line-items table.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which relation holds the line items?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the hydrated relation (list it in include) whose rows the ledger look tables.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: line items field, order lines, invoice lines, child rows

overridableConfigKeys.label: Loading placeholder
overridableConfigKeys.description: Shown while the record loads, shaped like what replaces it so the page does not jump: the detail skeleton for the panel/slide-over/page looks; a document-look consumer sets { type: skeleton, variant: text, rows: 8 }.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field is the longitude?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the longitude field the map look pins.

overridableConfigKeys.label: How many actions before collapsing?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Actions beyond this count collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: inline actions limit, overflow threshold

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field holds the images?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the field the showcase look leads with: one image URL, a list of URLs, or a list of { src, caption }.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: gallery field, photos field, images field, media field

overridableConfigKeys.label: When does this surface load?
overridableConfigKeys.description: init = a routed detail page; the record loads as soon as the page mounts (the default). event = an overlay that stays blank until a row-click OPEN_VIEW hands it an id, which is what a list-embedded slide-over needs — mounting an init-loading surface on a list page would fetch a record it has no id for.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: open on click, slide over, row click, blank until opened, list embedded

overridableConfigKeys.label: Page look body
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = page: a full record page, width-capped so field rows do not stretch past a readable measure (Almadar_UI_Beauty.md §3).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Placeholder text
overridableConfigKeys.description: Placeholder shown in the document body when it is empty.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Record look
overridableConfigKeys.description: How the record itself is arranged inside the panel/slide-over/page frame, so not every app reads as an admin form. panel = labelled field grid (default); profile = a person or member: avatar + cover hero (avatarField, coverField); showcase = image-first product or listing with a gallery (mediaField); workflow = a lifecycle stepper over the record (stageField, stages); map = a place: location map hero (latitudeField, longitudeField); ledger = an invoice/order document: line items then totals (lineItemsField, lineItemColumns, totals); conversation = a ticket or thread: the messages beside the record facts (threadField); workspace = a hub record with tabs (tabs). Regions with no data simply do not render. A region fed by a separate trait (replies with their composer, editable order lines, activity history) is composed by overriding the body and passing detail-panel's threadContent / lineItemsContent / activityContent.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: record style, profile page, product page, listing page, invoice view, ticket view, timeline view, tabbed record, location page

overridableConfigKeys.label: How should the fields be grouped?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Optional titled groups over `fields`, e.g. [{title: Contact, fields: [email, phone]}]. Group into sections of 3-5 once a record carries more than about seven fields — a flat list past that is the cognitive-load problem Almadar_UX.md §1.4 (Miller) describes. Empty = one ungrouped list, the default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: field groups, grouped fields, panel sections, fieldsets

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show the action buttons?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Set false for a read-only record view; a panel with actions nothing listens to is a dead affordance.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: read only, hide actions, view only

overridableConfigKeys.label: Slide-over look body
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = slide-over: the same panel as a right-hand drawer, so the list behind stays in place. Use when the record is a glance, not a workspace.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field is the lifecycle stage?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the field holding the record's current stage; the workflow look marks it on the stepper.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: stage field, status field, phase field, step field

overridableConfigKeys.label: What is the lifecycle, in order?
overridableConfigKeys.description: The workflow look's stepper: one { value, label } per stage, value matching stageField's enum.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: lifecycle, pipeline stages, steps, phases

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field is the subtitle?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the field shown under the title (e.g. company, category). Set to "" for no subtitle at all — the right choice for the document look, whose metadata lives in the properties strip, not a second line.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: subtitle field, secondary field, subheading, no subtitle

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which tabs follow the overview?
overridableConfigKeys.description: The workspace look's tabs after Overview: each lists field names, or composes a related trait as content (e.g. a company's deals list).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: tabs, record tabs, sub pages, related lists

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which relation holds the thread?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the hydrated relation (list it in include) whose messages the conversation look shows.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: messages field, replies field, comments field, thread field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field is the record's title?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the field on the loaded record shown as the panel title (e.g. contactName, subject, title).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: title field, heading field, name field, label field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which fields make up the title, in order?
overridableConfigKeys.description: For records whose name is split across fields (firstName + lastName): the listed fields' values joined with spaces become the title, and override titleField. Empty = titleField alone, the default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: full name, name parts, composite title, first and last name

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which fields are the totals?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Record fields shown under the line items in order (e.g. subtotal, tax, total); the last is emphasised.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: totals, subtotal, grand total, amount due

overridableConfigKeys.label: Viewer's role
overridableConfigKeys.description: The signed-in viewer's role that each action's `roles` is checked against. Bind it explicitly at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`) in an app whose identity carries a role; left empty, only actions with no `roles` show.

events.name: META_SAVED
events.description: A property in the settings rail committed in place; patch carries the row id plus the one changed field, ready to hand straight to a persist update. Quiet contract: the host persists without refetching or repainting the open document.
events.synonyms: property saved, metadata changed, field committed, update property

events.name: RELATION_OPEN
events.description: A relation chip in the details drawer was clicked (a tag, the author, the category); id is the linked row's id. Hosts route it to the linked record's own surface — a navigate, a scoped overlay, a filtered list.
events.synonyms: open relation, linked record clicked, tag clicked, chip clicked

events.name: SHOW_DETAILS
events.description: The document finished loading; stash the row the details drawer will show. Hosts route the doc trait's RecordItemLoaded (or SlugLoaded first element) here.
events.synonyms: record loaded, show metadata, populate details

events.name: OPEN_DETAILS
events.description: Open the details drawer. Hosts route the document's Details action (e.g. Doc.VIEW_INFO) here.
events.synonyms: show info, open details, document info, page info

events.name: CLOSE
events.description: Close the details drawer; the drawer chrome's X / backdrop dismiss emits this.
events.synonyms: dismiss, close drawer, hide details

events.name: META_CHANGE
events.description: A property in the rail committed (switch toggled, select changed, text blurred).
events.synonyms: property changed, metadata edited, field committed

overridableConfigKeys.label: Details drawer content tree
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr painted into the drawer slot on OPEN_DETAILS; binds the row stashed by SHOW_DETAILS. Info-only by default — no metaCommitEvent, so every row displays rather than edits (editing rides the document's actions menu). Override at the call site to extend the panel or to opt into in-place commits via metaCommitEvent: META_CHANGE.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Details drawer heading
overridableConfigKeys.description: Heading of the settings card (e.g. Details, Page info, Document settings).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which metadata properties appear in the details drawer?
overridableConfigKeys.description: The record's metadata shown as read-only INFO in the details drawer (Updated, address, status, …). Editing metadata is a normal action under the document's menu, not an inline affordance here.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: properties, metadata fields, document info, page info, front matter

capabilities: record detail, single record view, entity detail panel, drill-down record, show one record, record profile, detail page, view details, document editor, wiki page, note taking, article body, rich text editing, write and edit content
